title: Color Cascade
tagline: Match the falling colors before they overwhelm you!
pitch: Players rotate a multi-colored paddle to catch falling color-coded blocks. Match the block's color to the paddle segment to score and prevent overflow.
coreLoop: Observe falling blocks, rotate paddle to match color, catch block, repeat.

mechanics.name: Paddle Rotation
mechanics.description: A circular paddle at the bottom of the screen has 3-4 segments, each a different color. Players rotate this paddle left or right.

mechanics.name: Color Matching
mechanics.description: Blocks of various colors fall from the top. Catching a block with a matching paddle segment scores points and removes the block. Mismatching or missing a block adds to an 'overflow' meter.

mechanics.name: Combo Multiplier
mechanics.description: Catching multiple blocks of the same color consecutively, or matching multiple blocks quickly, increases a score multiplier.

mechanics.name: Special Blocks
mechanics.description: Occasionally, 'wildcard' blocks (match any color) or 'bomb' blocks (clear surrounding blocks on impact) will fall.

controls.keyboard: Left/Right arrow keys or A/D to rotate paddle.
controls.mouse: Mouse movement left/right rotates paddle; click to trigger a power-up (if applicable).

artDirection.backgroundFx: subtle, slow-moving abstract geometric patterns or color gradients that react subtly to gameplay events.

audioDirection.musicMood: upbeat, rhythmic, synth-wave, increasing in tempo with difficulty

difficulty.start: Slow fall speed, 3 paddle segments, only single color blocks.
difficulty.progression: Increase fall speed, increase block density, introduce more paddle segments (up to 4), introduce special blocks, introduce 'multi-color' blocks that require two specific segments.
difficulty.peak: Extremely fast fall speed, dense block showers, complex block types, narrow 'safe' zones for catching.

winLose.win: Score as many points as possible before the overflow meter fills.
winLose.lose: The 'overflow' meter at the side of the screen fills up from missed blocks or mismatches.

juice.screenShake: On bomb block explosion, on overflow meter filling significantly, on game over.
juice.particles: Vibrant color burst particles on successful match, dark 'splatter' particles on mismatch/miss, glowing particles for special blocks.
juice.hitStop: Brief moment on significant combo achievement or bomb block activation.
juice.flash: Paddle segment flashes brightly on successful match, screen briefly flashes red on overflow meter critical.

scopeNotes: Do not implement multiple paddle types or unlockable skins. Focus on core mechanics and block variety. No tutorial levels, brief on-screen instructions only.

scoreEvents: Player catches a matching color block (base score + combo multiplier)
Player catches a wildcard block (base score)
Player triggers a bomb block (score based on cleared blocks)
